note: Small primitive Cherokee NF campground (Tellico Ranger District) in the North River valley, about 3 miles up gravel FR 217 off FR 210 from Tellico Plains. Drive-in sites with table, fire ring and lantern post; sites 5 and 6 sit side by side. The Forest Service gives no rig length; campers report rigs to about 25 ft, and low branches are a caveat for tall rigs. Bear food-storage rules apply. --Claude
